assets.purpose: Approve the default table materials, readable active authority, six destination previews, and restrained lighting.
assets.prompt: Cinematic product-design style frame for OBSCUR: THE SIXFOLD ROAD, a premium physical ritual board game viewed near top-down in a 16:9 composition. A blackened-brass spiral road with exactly thirty-six sockets sits in smoke-dark lacquered wood. Six small heraldic porcelain mask tokens occupy the road. One traveler is unmistakably active through a restrained warm-gold pool of light and a lit sigil, while exactly six reachable destinations are legible as small physical edge markers numbered one through six with ivory, oxidized-cyan, and ember-red class accents. A bone-ivory die rests in the central mechanism. Shared Static appears as a few fine red-white interference veins spreading from the heart, clearly below crisis. Two tokens share one taut warm-gold filament anchored between them. Leave clean dark negative space for real interface typography. Museum-grade materials, tactile depth, quiet dread, readable gameplay first, restrained cinematic lighting, no prerecorded-video screen.
